feeds.title: Kellys Thoughts On Things
feeds.description: Kellys Thoughts On Things is a blog by Kelly. She is a woman who loves to create recipes, travel with her family, and make every day memorable and fun! Sign up and get all the latest thoughts in your inbox.

feeds.title: Tidbits of Experience
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Crystal Green. A wife and homeschooling mother of 3, sharing my and family's experiences so you can make the most of yours! We have plenty of lessons we've learned along the way that we feel can help you make your life better. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: The Cinnamonmom Mom
feeds.description: I'm Tasheena, a kindergarten teacher turned stay-at-home mom living my best life in SC. I love sharing tips for managing a household, fun learning activities, and family-friendly food! Subscribe to my blog for more ideas, tips, and special offers!

feeds.title: Andrea Beam
feeds.description: Hey, ya'll. My name is Andrea Beam. I am a journalist and freelance writer, a lover of all things Greenville and the world's 'okay-est' mom. Follow my blog to get the latest updates on daily life, family, parenting, and travel.

feeds.title: This Side of Heaven Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Kristi, and I am a pastor's wife, a former public school teacher, and a stay-at-home mom of seven children - two on Earth and five in Heaven. My writing tends to center around parenting, homeschooling, and pregnancy and infant loss, and a few other topics. Subscribe to keep up with This Side of Heaven.

feeds.title: Faust Island
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amber and I love my family. I am an affiliate and a mom influencer. I'm happily learning along the way and I enjoy writing about it. Follow the blog to get posts on sustainable living tips, food, health, wellness, parenting topics, crafts, kids book reviews, and fun family activities.

feeds.title: Everything Mommyhood
feeds.description: My name is Darci Bean and I'm the owner and author of Everything Mommyhood, a lifestyle, and travel blog. I'm a 30-something mom living the best life with an amazing man and two beautiful girls. Subscribe to the blog to get blogger support and advice, networking, opportunities, and more.

feeds.title: Handstand Happiness
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Shana. Child of God, wife, mom to 2 boys (and 2 labs), Physical Therapist, yoga instructor, and MADabolic trainer. I have a passion for sharing things about all things above, as well as fashion, good eats, wine, my city, traveling, and having fun and that is what Handstand Happiness is all about. You will find a little bit of everything here. Follow to get the updates.

feeds.title: Written Reality
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mitzi. Clinging to visions of the picture-perfect home filled with gourmet meals and tons of family fun, I resigned from my full-time teaching position to take on my new role as a stay-at-home mom.Written Reality is a great place for a mom looking for encouragement throughout your everyday experiences. Join us for housekeeping tips, easy recipes, and tons of ideas for family fun.

feeds.title: Our Southern Home Blog
feeds.description: I'm Christy from Upstate, South Carolina! I'm a wife and mom to 2 college kids at Clemson University! I love decorating our home with a mixture of bargain and high-end style for an eclectic look that is continually evolving. You'll find a little bit of everything here from decorating, recipes, and travel to fashion and beauty!

feeds.title: The Audrey Reel
feeds.description: Audrey is a recent mother, wife, yoga instructor, fitness lover, artist, DIY-er, real estate marketing director, and personal real estate investor with a passion for home design sharing her love and experience with others.
